title: “I’m Constantly Getting Comments Like, ‘Oh, You’re Blind. You’re Like the Only Woman That I Stand a Chance With.’”: A Study of Blind TikTokers’ Intersectional Experiences of Gender and Sexuality
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative empirical study focusing on the human-computer interaction (HCI) and social media experiences of blind individuals through the lenses of gender and sexuality. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethical/moral frameworks.
